name: BRL Carry Deterioration: MXN & ZAR Hedge Effectiveness
description: Measures how well shorting MXN or ZAR hedges a long BRL carry position when BRL carry-to-vol deteriorates below its 12-month average. Loads USDBRL via reference FX, computes BRL monthly carry from Brazil discount rate (INTDSRBRM193N) minus Fed Funds (FEDFUNDS), normalizes by 30-day realized vol, and generates a signal when carry-to-vol falls below its 252-bar rolling mean. Per-asset outputs (USDMXN, USDZAR) show next-month log returns conditioned on signal regime. Dashboard: BRL carry-to-vol line chart, cs_lines spread, cs_summary_table with conditional stats, per-asset bar charts of signal-on returns, and event markers for deterioration onset.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BRL CARRY DETERIORATION: DO MXN/ZAR SHORTS HEDGE A LONG BRL CARRY?
# =============================================================================
# Signal: BRL carry-to-vol < 12-month rolling mean (carry deteriorating)
# Hedge instruments: short USDMXN, short USDZAR (USD strength = short EM profit)
# Forward return: next-month log return (positive = USD appreciation = short EM profitable)
# Monthly sampling at month-end boundaries
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# USDBRL REFERENCE DATA (shared across all assets)
# =============================================================================

brl_ref = fx_pairs(ticker="USDBRL")()
brl_close = ffill(brl_ref.c)

# =============================================================================
# INTEREST RATES: BRL discount rate & USD Fed Funds (FRED)
# =============================================================================

brl_rate_data = economic_indicators(series_id="INTDSRBRM193N")()
usd_rate_data = economic_indicators(series_id="FEDFUNDS")()
brl_rate = ffill(brl_rate_data.result)
usd_rate = ffill(usd_rate_data.result)

# =============================================================================
# BRL CARRY-TO-VOL SIGNAL
# =============================================================================

# Monthly carry = (BRL rate - USD rate) / 1200
brl_monthly_carry = (brl_rate - usd_rate) / 1200.0

# 30-day realized vol of USDBRL (annualized)
brl_log_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.log)(brl_close)
brl_real_vol = stddev(period=30)(brl_log_ret) * sqrt(252)

# Carry-to-vol ratio
brl_ctv = brl_monthly_carry / brl_real_vol

# 12-month rolling mean of carry-to-vol (~252 trading days)
brl_ctv_ma = ma(period=252)(brl_ctv)

# Signal: carry-to-vol below its 12-month average = deterioration
brl_signal = is_valid(brl_ctv) and is_valid(brl_ctv_ma) and (brl_ctv < brl_ctv_ma)

# Spread for cs_lines: positive = above average, negative = below = signal on
brl_ctv_spread = brl_ctv - brl_ctv_ma

# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL ONSET DETECTION (first month of deterioration episode)
# =============================================================================

brl_signal_prev = brl_signal >> 1
is_onset = brl_signal and not brl_signal_prev

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURNS (next ~21 trading days log return on hedge instruments)
# =============================================================================

fwd_ret = forward_returns(period=21, return_type=ReturnType.log)(close)

# =============================================================================
# MONTH-END SAMPLING
# =============================================================================

is_month_end = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, boundary=BoundaryType.end)(bar_idx)

signal_on = is_month_end and brl_signal
signal_off = is_month_end and (not brl_signal)

# Regime-filtered forward returns
fwd_ret_on = where(signal_on, fwd_ret)
fwd_ret_off = where(signal_off, fwd_ret)

# Hit rate: fwd_ret > 0 means USD appreciated (short EM profitable)
hit_on = where(signal_on, 1.0 if fwd_ret > 0 else 0.0)
hit_off = where(signal_off, 1.0 if fwd_ret > 0 else 0.0)

# Count helpers
count_on = 1.0 if signal_on else 0.0
count_off = 1.0 if signal_off else 0.0
count_on_clean = count_on if is_valid(count_on) else 0.0
count_off_clean = count_off if is_valid(count_off) else 0.0

# Return spread: signal_on minus signal_off average (for summary table)
# Computed as per-observation for cs_summary_table agg=Mean
# The table will show mean of each column per asset

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- Chart 1 (per-asset): BRL Carry-to-Vol vs 12M Rolling Mean ---
xy_lines(
    title='BRL Carry-to-Vol vs 12M Rolling Mean',
    category='BRL Carry Signal',
    y_axis_label='Carry / Vol',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BRL Carry-to-Vol', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='12M Rolling Mean', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Signal Active', color=Color.Indigo, is_band=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_idx, brl_ctv, brl_ctv_ma, brl_signal)

# --- Chart 2 (cross-sectional): CTV Spread (same for both assets) ---
cs_lines(
    title='BRL Carry-to-Vol Minus 12M Mean (Negative = Signal On)',
    category='BRL Carry Signal',
    y_axis_label='CTV Spread',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    area=True,
    order=1
)(bar_idx, brl_ctv_spread)

# --- Summary Table: Conditional Performance ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='Hedge Performance: Signal ON vs OFF',
    category='Hedge Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Hedge Performance',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Fwd Ret (Signal ON)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Fwd Ret (Signal OFF)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate (Signal ON)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate (Signal OFF)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='# Months Signal ON', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum),
            ColumnSpec(title='# Months Signal OFF', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum)
        ]
    ),
    order=2
)(fwd_ret_on, fwd_ret_off, hit_on, hit_off, count_on_clean, count_off_clean)

# --- Chart 3 (per-asset): Bar chart of signal-on monthly forward returns ---
xy_bars(
    title='Next-Month Returns During BRL Carry Deterioration',
    category='Hedge Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Avg Next-Month Log Return',
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Signal ON', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Signal OFF', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=3
)(fwd_ret_on, fwd_ret_off)

# --- Event Markers: BRL carry deterioration onset ---
onset_ctv = where(is_onset, brl_ctv)
onset_ma = where(is_onset, brl_ctv_ma)
onset_vol = where(is_onset, brl_real_vol)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='BRL Carry Deterioration Onset',
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Carry-to-Vol', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='12M Mean', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='BRL Real Vol', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    )
)(is_onset, onset_ctv, onset_ma, onset_vol)
